company.name: Pennine Mechanical & Heating Services Ltd
company.description: Independent plumbing, electrical, heating and ventilation (HVAC) contractor serving domestic, commercial and social-housing customers across Leeds, Sheffield, Manchester and the M62 corridor. Runs a fleet of Gas Safe registered van-based engineers, NICEIC approved electricians and F-Gas certified refrigeration/air-conditioning technicians on planned maintenance contracts, reactive call-outs and boiler/plant installation works. Each van is a mobile workshop carrying managed van-stock of fittings, controls, flue components and refrigerant, with PAT-tested power tools, calibrated combustion analysers and electrical test instruments. Dispatch and service-call ETA are managed in FleetFlow, alongside DVSA MOT, DVLA, GB goods-vehicle operator licensing where applicable, EU/GB tachograph and drivers' hours for the larger vans, ADR/Carriage of Dangerous Goods for refrigerant and gas-cylinder loads, Gas Safe and NICEIC scheme compliance, F-Gas (EU 517/2014 retained in GB) certification, and trade-certification/licence expiry tracking.

notes.author: Gavin Holroyd
notes.body: Block C servicing: 6 of 8 dwellings serviced and CP12s issued. Two no-access (flats 14 and 19) despite housing officer arranging - left cards and rebooked for Thursday. Flat 8 combi found with cracked fan housing, classified At Risk under the Gas Industry Unsafe Situations Procedure and capped with tenant agreement. Fan assembly collected from City Plumbing to return and recommission.

notes.author: Marcus Whitfield
notes.body: EICR across three Hebden Bridge terraces. Number 12 came back unsatisfactory - original rewireable fuseboard, no RCD protection on socket circuits (C2), and no surge protection (C3 advisory). Reported C2 to landlord same day per the Electrical Safety Standards in the Private Rented Sector Regulations 2020. Quoted metal 18th edition consumer unit with RCBOs. Other two properties satisfactory.

notes.author: Rhys Davies
notes.body: First-time fix on the Hebden Bridge reactive. Seized diverter valve on the combi - swapped the cartridge from van stock, refilled and vented, hot water and heating both back. Tenant is elderly and was without heating overnight so this was prioritised. No need for temporary heaters. Diverter cartridge now below van minimum, reorder raised.

notes.author: Sanjay Mistry
notes.body: Quarterly F-Gas service at Northgate. Five of fourteen units done on the after-hours visit. Indoor unit 9 had a minor leak at a flare joint - cut back, re-flared and pressure tested OK. Logged the small R32 top-up against the site F-Gas register and updated the per-unit logbook. Remaining nine units to be finished on the next after-hours slot.

notes.author: Sanjay Mistry
notes.body: Pharmacy AC call-out hit within the 4-hour SLA. Unit was tripping on high pressure - condenser coil was badly fouled with leaf litter and dust. Cleaned the coil, found a chattering contactor and replaced it, topped up the charge slightly and the unit is holding pressures now. Recommended the FM move this unit onto quarterly coil cleans given its location.

notes.author: Workshop (Connor Ainsworth)
notes.body: MF71 DDU came in with a DPF efficiency code (P2002) and soot load at 92 percent after a lot of short urban install runs. Forced regen completed and soot dropped back, but it is also due its scheduled service and the MOT is on the 29th, so keeping it in to do all three together. Should be back on the road for Wednesday's install.

notes.author: Operations (Peter)
notes.body: Iwona's Gas Safe ACS reassessment (CCN1/CENWAT) expires 18 July. Booked her ACS reassessment day at the training centre for 8 July so there is no lapse. Reminder set - she must not carry out gas work after expiry until the new certificate is uploaded to FleetFlow.

notes.author: Aaron Bennett
notes.body: Monthly Legionella monitoring at Moorlands House under ACoP L8. Eight sentinel outlets logged and twelve TMVs serviced. One basin return came back below 50C - flushed the outlet through and it recovered, re-tested OK. Logged everything in the L8 logbook and Rhys signed off as supervising plumber.

notes.author: Despatch (Peter)
notes.body: Aire Valley reported a gas smell at Hunslet block C flat 22 at 16:40. Treating as an uncontrolled gas escape - Gavin diverted in VEH-001 first thing tomorrow on a one-hour priority. If he cannot make it safe he is to fit a warning notice and we will need to advise the tenant and contact Northern Gas Networks on the emergency line. Standing down lower-priority CP12 stop if needed.

notes.author: Iwona Kaczmarek
notes.body: Brunswick Court header replacement is hot works in a communal plant room - I will not start cutting until the managing agent signs the hot works permit and the communal supply is isolated between 09:00 and 12:00. Bringing the oxy-acetylene set and will keep a one-hour fire watch after brazing. Aaron to act as fire watch.

notes.author: Connor Ainsworth
notes.body: Ellison boiler swap is a two-day job - day one strip out the back boiler and first fix plus a full powerflush, day two commissioning and Benchmark. Customer has financed through Ideal Premier so I need to register the 10-year warranty and submit the Gas Safe Building Regs notification at handover. Note - they have a dog, always ring ahead.

notes.author: Sanjay Mistry
notes.body: Vito F-Gas van loaded with R32 and R410A plus a recovery cylinder for the Northgate after-hours work. Cylinders strapped into the rack per ADR and the utility box cage is armed. Recovered 0.8kg of R32 today which I have returned to the merchant reclaim scheme - logged on the recovery paperwork.

notes.author: Rhys Davies
notes.body: Sent Aaron to run the Wolseley collection for the TMV cartridges while I finished the temperature monitoring at Moorlands House - kept us on schedule. He is third year and competent on collections; still supervising all live plumbing work directly.
